interface.signature: def countOfSubstrings(S: str, K: int) -> int:

preconditions.description: K must be a positive integer within the bounds of the string length S.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: S consists only of lowercase alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(S) - K + 1) if len(set(S[i:i+K])) == K - 1)
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of all substrings of length K in S that contain exactly K-1 distinct characters.
